files.description: Repository conventions: multi-module workspace layout, build/test/lint commands, Provider/Client/MultiProvider architecture, per-module release/tagging process.
Package-level overview and usage patterns for the Provider/Client API.
The Provider and OTPProvider interfaces, WebhookParser signature, Message/Result/Status/DeliveryStatus shapes, sentinel errors, and Client every provider module implements against.
Provider-agnostic phone validation/normalization (ValidateE164, NormalizePhone) and segment counting (CalculateSegments) that providers should reuse rather than reimplement.
The linter ruleset already enforced in CI; avoid duplicating what golangci-lint already flags.
